ran: ANTHROPIC_MODEL or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL set in settings env blocks and the shell: User block vs project model key (m6), User block vs shell (m7), project vs User block (m8), local vs project block (m9), --settings block vs shell (m10), User block CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL vs project effortLevel (e5).
result: Every settings env block beat the shell, and between files the higher file won. A User env block's ANTHROPIC_MODEL beat a project model key, and a User env block's CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL beat a project effortLevel.
method: dashboard/experiments/harness: claude -p in a throwaway HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and project under $TMPDIR, a fake key and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL on 127.0.0.1. fakeapi.py logs the model, output_config.effort and cache_control ttl of each request and answers 400; for agent cases it first streams one Agent tool call. The harness only allows requests to fakeapi.py on 127.0.0.1. Managed settings were not tested, because writing them needs admin rights.
